body:
Twenty-six years ago, one piece started Energy Muse: the Prosperity Necklace. It became the necklace thousands reached for when they were ready to call in more.

This is its next evolution — and we took ten years to get it right. We wouldn't release an update until we found a coin that energetically expedited you to your next version of self. That coin is the gold Torus.

The Torus is the shape of infinite prosperity made physical — the self-renewing pattern found in everything from a single atom to a galaxy to the field around your own body. Energy flows outward, circles back, and feeds itself again, endlessly. Abundance that never depletes. Where the original formula reached back to ancient coins, this one draws from sacred geometry and the now: your future prosperity, generated from who you are today.

Gold because gold is the highest frequency — the golden ray, the native vibration of wealth and riches. When you wear it, you become the golden coin. Your field shines, elevates, tunes to receive.

Jade beads carry the steady energy of lasting wealth, keeping you calm and clear enough to hold what's growing. Red string activates the piece and seals your intention into the field, protecting the flow of energy as it moves to you.

This is wellness tech for now. A belief-system tool to help you align to the signal of infinite prosperity — the 888 wealth code — and create your next chapter from this moment forward.
